(models in subdirectories like photo/sd15.ckpt will be listed as just sd15.ckpt)
Allow http:// and https:// URLs for input images in API
Write prompts to file: Create a new .txt file for every batch containing the prompt template as well as the generated prompts.

Name of your desired inpaint model (img2img-inpaint). Default is vanilla sd-v1-5-inpainting.ckpt
Complete documentation is available at https://github.com/adieyal/sd-dynamic-prompts. Please report any issues on GitHub.
Keyframe values such as 0: (1.00), 1: (1.53). Leave empty for the classic steady zoom

the required timestamp to reference when resuming. Currently only available in 2D & 3D mode, the timestamp is saved as the settings .txt file name as well as images produced during your previous run. The format follows: yyyymmddhhmmss - a timestamp of when the run was started to diffuse.
